<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex01112025-05-0716-13-582" status="reviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Incipit (1b1)"/>
         <pb edRef="inst:4440" n="1b"/><lb edRef="inst:4440" n="1b1"/> <lg><l>'jig rten kun dang myi mthun pa'i ||</l>
         <l>zab mo'i don can <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3749">bstan chos 'di</rs> ||</l>
         <l>thugs rjes bdag cag la gsungs pa || </l>
         <l>chos la spyan gyur <rs type="deity">de</rs> la 'dud || </l></lg>
         <note type="translation">I bow to him (i.e., Maitreya) whose eyes are directed towards the Dharma and who, out of compassion, taught to us this treatise of profound meaning (i.e., the Ratnagotravibhāga), which goes against [the conventional wisdom of] the entire world.</note></seg></TEI>
